text.tspan: TCP connection states (the names ss shows)
Opening: client on the left, server on the right
many = server or firewall not answering
sent SYN-ACK, waits for the final ACK
Closing: the side that closes first takes the left path
normal: kept 2 × MSL (60 s on Linux) so
peer closed, but this app hasn't
called close() yet. Many that never
